sample_unit: synthetic vignettes and discharge summaries (1,000 vignettes; 90 discharge summaries)
unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to flag errors in clinical documentation as a safety check
Hybrid human-AI review of clinical documentation
Running a local (on-premise) LLM for error detection

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (GPT o4-mini, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemma 3 27B) against clinicians for detecting and localizing synthetic errors in oncologic clinical documentation. It tests model accuracy on simulated vignettes rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
